name: Qutbism
summary: Qutbism is the Sunni Islamist doctrine of Sayyid Qutb. It holds that sovereignty and legislation belong to God alone, that societies not ruled by sharia live in a new jahiliyyah, and that a committed vanguard must break from them and establish Islamic order through preaching and, where needed, jihad. It rejects nationalism, secularism, democracy, socialism and capitalism as man-made systems, while urging social justice under divine law.
scope: The Sunni Islamist thought of Sayyid Qutb, in the radical phase of his career that Milestones (1964) and the later volumes of In the Shade of the Qur'an represent, plus his earlier Islamist works such as Social Justice in Islam (1949), as the Parameters article (s2) and the Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy (s3) present it. Eikmeier says the name covers Qutb's writings and those of other theorists such as Maududi and al-Banna; this audit keeps to Qutb's own texts and the accounts of them. It excludes the later jihadist organisations (al-Qaeda, Islamic State, Takfir wa Hijra) that claimed his legacy, whose acts the IEP doubts he would have approved, and the mainstream Muslim Brotherhood that refuted Milestones.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb holds that class and ethnic distinctions do not affect status in the ideal society, only piety, virtue and competence.

ban-interest.rationale: Milestones records that usury was prohibited by Islam, and the IEP account says Qutb opposes usury in the Islamic economic order.

civilians-legitimate-targets.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb accepted the traditional rule of Islamic law that non-combatants are not to be targeted.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Milestones makes freedom from servitude to other men the aim of Islam and condemns rule of one people over another.

class-collaboration.rationale: Milestones rejects class struggle as a corrupt theory and says Islam removes class distinctions and joins all races and classes in one community.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Milestones names class struggle among the corrupt theories of those who deviate from the Divine system and calls them enemies of mankind.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Milestones says a Muslim's nationality is not that determined by a government or country, and the soil has no value in itself.

consent-of-governed.rationale: The IEP account has authority come from God alone, yet the imam is chosen by the whole community and obeyed only while he obeys God.

constituent-assembly.rationale: No human body may claim sovereignty in Qutb's doctrine, so a constitution written by an assembly as the supreme law contradicts it.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Milestones divides cultures into Islamic culture and the jahili cultures of the rest, and holds the Islamic way alone to be the Divine one.

defensive-jihad-duty.rationale: Milestones holds that defending the Muslim community and its homeland by force is part of jihad, and the IEP account says Muslims have an obligation to defend themselves.

democracy-best.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb rejects the term democracy as government by the people instead of by God, and Milestones rejects 'Islamic Democracy' as an appeasement.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: The IEP account says he rejects democracy as government by the people instead of by God, so fair elections cannot suffice for legitimacy.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: Milestones calls communist society jahili for submitting to the party and rejects class-based rule.

direct-votes.rationale: God is the only sovereign and lawgiver in his doctrine, so citizens deciding laws by vote claim a right that Qutb reserves to God.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Milestones praises the community in which people of all races, nations and colours were members, with no trace of racial distinction.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb holds men fitted for the world of work and leadership of the family, women for the home, and that women should not work outside it unless necessary.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: The IEP account says that God is the only sovereign morally, legally and politically, and Milestones makes God's rule the core of its programme.

divinely-chosen-superior-people.rationale: The IEP account says the only significant distinction among humans in God's sight is obedience, not race, ethnicity or nationality.

elective-rulers.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb outlines an imam nominated by community leaders and chosen by the whole community.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Qutb holds God's Shari'a to be the only supreme law, so a man-made document limiting government as the highest law contradicts it.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: The IEP account says all are of equal value regardless of race or class, while also keeping dhimmi limits and different functions for the sexes.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Milestones calls Islam a declaration of man's freedom from servitude to other men, including where no force is used.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Qutb holds women should not work outside the home unless it is absolutely necessary and should not mix publicly with men.

gender-social-construct.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb holds that women and men differ in temperament (women more emotional, men more rational) and that this fits them for different functions.

gradual-change.rationale: Milestones says the change from jahiliyyah to Islam is vast and far-reaching, and condemns presenting Islam as needing only slight change to the world's current systems.

harm-principle.rationale: The IEP account says the Shari'a classifies all actions as obligatory, reprehensible or forbidden for a society governed by it, not only harm to others.

homeland-spiritual-bond.rationale: Milestones says the soil has no value in itself and that the Muslim's homeland is not a piece of land.

human-decline-since-golden-age.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb sees history as prophetic high points followed by decline, with the Muslim community declining morally over twelve centuries.

initiating-nondefensive-force-unjustifie.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb calls limiting jihad to defence defeatist and argues for initiating violence to remove obstacles to Islam; Milestones makes the same case.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Qutb holds that Muslims must derive their principles of government from the Qur'an, not from Western systems such as democracy.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb is inclined to oppose Muslim men marrying Jewish or Christian women today, as it may weaken the faith.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Milestones holds that the whole modern world, including the West, is jahili and that the change to Islam is vast and far-reaching.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Milestones says that for a Muslim nationality means belief and way of life, not race, language or country.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb's ideal society recognizes the sovereignty of God alone and is governed by the Islamic Shari'a, derived from the Qur'an and Sunna.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Milestones rejects the materialistic interpretation of history and scientific socialism, holding that values are fixed and not driven by economics.

military-force-beyond-defence.rationale: Milestones says jihad is not only for defence of the homeland of Islam, and the IEP account says Muslims must fight tyranny wherever it appears.

more-religion-public.rationale: Milestones demands that principles of government, politics and economics all be drawn from the Qur'an, and the IEP account says all activity is to be service to God.

national-self-determination.rationale: Milestones says nationality means belief and a way of life, not membership of a nation, so a nation's claim to a state is not recognised.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: Milestones condemns capitalism with its monopolies and usury, and communism as jahili, and presents Islam as the only Divine alternative.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Qutb makes armed jihad, defensive and offensive, an obligation of the Muslim community.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Qutb's Islamic state governs the whole life of society under the Shari'a, including economic redistribution and morality.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb places a moral obligation on individuals to assist the needy and contribute to social causes, beyond zakat.

one-party-rule.rationale: Milestones calls the communist society jahili because it submits to the Communist Party rather than to God.

one-spouse-at-a-time.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb defends polygyny, at least under certain conditions.

parliament-supreme.rationale: The IEP account says no human ruler or nation may claim sovereignty; in his outline a consultative council exists beneath God's law.

patriotic-education.rationale: Milestones treats pride of lineage, nationality and country as ties that faith must replace.

political-violence-legitimate.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb argued for the need for violence, including initiating it at times, and Eikmeier says Qutbism justifies armed jihad.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb frames jahiliyya as an aggressive force defeated only by jihad, the most important human task.

priority-to-poor.rationale: The IEP account says the needy have a recognized right to a share of the community's wealth and the leader may tax further to assist them.

promote-democracy-abroad.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb rejects democracy as rule by the people instead of God, so a government promoting it contradicts him.

property-fundamental.rationale: Milestones counts private property among the expressions of individuality that communism destroys, while the IEP account says Qutb limits property by zakat, further taxation and the needy's right to a share.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: The IEP account says all wealth belongs to God and is entrusted to individuals, with property limited by zakat and the community's needs.

racial-franchise.rationale: The IEP account says class, racial and ethnic distinctions will not influence people's status in his ideal society.

racial-pride.rationale: Milestones says pride of lineage and nationality had to leave the first Muslims' hearts, and calls ties of race and colour low associations.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Milestones says Islam removes the walls of race and colour, and the IEP account says all are of equal value regardless of race.

reason-over-faith.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb rejects philosophy as an attempt to do with reason what only revelation can do and takes Islam from the Qur'an exclusively.

reinterpret-religion.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb opposes reinterpreting rulings to fit Western values and where a clear text exists, but favours fiqh that responds to the movement's changing conditions.

religion-illusion.rationale: Qutb holds the Islamic conception to be true and divinely sourced, and Milestones says communism wrongly deprives people of spiritual needs and belief in God.

religion-oppresses-women.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb holds that divine law protects women and that jahili society exploits them.

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: Qutb makes the Shari'a the sole law of the state, with Jews and Christians holding protected status under it.

religious-nation.rationale: Milestones says a Muslim has no nationality except his belief, which makes him a member of the Muslim community.

religious-offensive-war.rationale: Qutb holds that Muslims must fight to remove the political powers blocking the preaching of Islam and to establish God's rule on earth, including by initiating force, though no one is to be forced to believe.

restore-past-order.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb rejects the idea of continuous moral progress, holds the Medina community to be the high point of history and makes the first Qur'anic generation the model for today's activists.

revolution-legitimate.rationale: Milestones calls for a movement to strike at political powers ruling by other than God's law, and the IEP account says jihad takes the form of revolution in the present.

sacred-nation.rationale: Milestones says the soil of the homeland has in itself no value and that a Muslim's nationality is his belief.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Qutb gives sovereignty to God alone and has the imam obeyed only so far as he obeys God, so no ruler is sacred.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: The IEP account says that Qutb holds the Qur'an to contain the verbatim words of God.

scripture-judged-by-women.rationale: Qutb takes the Qur'an as the verbatim word of God, the source from which values are derived, not something judged by a human standard.

separate-church-state.rationale: Milestones calls for the principles of government to be derived from the Qur'an, and the IEP account describes a state governed by the Shari'a.

shared-marital-authority.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb holds that men have the right to leadership within the family and women the right to protection.

small-step-social-reform.rationale: Milestones says the change to Islam is vast and far-reaching and that jahili systems must be abolished, not adjusted a little.

smash-state-machine.rationale: Milestones calls for abolishing all systems based on the rule of man and establishing a new Islamic system in their place.

social-market-economy.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb guarantees private property as a reward for work and limits it by zakat, extra taxation and the needy's right to a share.

socialized-care.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb makes women's primary role caring for the family and holds that young children should be cared for in the home, not in crèches.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: The IEP account says the imam is obeyed except where he commands disobedience to God, and God's law is sovereign.

spiritual-nature.rationale: Milestones faults communism for depriving people of their spiritual needs, foremost belief in God.

state-harmful.rationale: His ideal society is governed by the Shari'a under an imam with a consultative council, so a society with no state contradicts it.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: Milestones says that a society in which belief in God is denied is jahili, and the IEP account has the state governed by the Shari'a.

state-supports-good-ways-of-life.rationale: Qutb's state enforces the Shari'a and makes all activity service to God.

taxation-theft.rationale: The IEP account says zakat is an obligation and the political leader may tax further when needed for the community's welfare.

tech-with-ancestral-values.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb encourages developing the earth technologically and purifying science, while drawing values and law from Islam alone.

total-state.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb holds Islam to be a comprehensive system for all of life, with the state a necessary part of it.

traditional-family.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb holds the family to be the basic unit of society, rooted in the cosmic order, with obedience to God in family matters a form of service to God.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb defends the dhimma system by which Jews and Christians follow their own creeds but under limits and the jizya.

universal-morality.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb holds ethical values to be fixed, derived from the one God and binding on all humans.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Milestones calls for striking at political powers that rule without God's commandments, and the IEP account says jahili leaders are to be replaced through jihad.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: The IEP account says Qutb calls for organized groups that struggle (jihad) to build an Islamic society, and that one cannot understand the Qur'an without joining that struggle.

workers-councils.rationale: Qutb rejects class-based systems and holds that sovereignty belongs to God alone, so councils of workers as the basis of political power contradict both.

missingStatements.text: Sovereignty belongs to God alone, so no human assembly or ruler may make law of its own.
missingStatements.rationale: Hakimiyya is the core of Milestones: no sovereignty or law except God's and no authority of one man over another.

missingStatements.text: Armed struggle is justified to remove political systems that stand in the way of a religion being preached and practised.
missingStatements.rationale: Milestones' jihad chapter calls for movement and force to remove the obstacles of jahili political power.
